title: Respect Method Flow witness auto-promotion
failure_signature: A wrapper requested validated to validated after the pass-witness command had already auto-promoted the method.
trigger_preconditions: The Method Flow runner records a passing witness for a candidate method.
candidate_workaround: Read the state returned by the witness command and transition directly from validated to preferred only once.
recurrence_guard: Do not hard-code a second validated transition after a passing witness.
rollback: Retain the rejected transition and resume from the ledger's actual valid state without rebuilding the ledger.
scope_boundary: Method Flow state handling only; no broader evidence credit.
